jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(E) inventory: Cambridge School District, a town school district in the Lamoille North Supervisory Union (member town: Cambridge). The district operates PK-6; grades 7-12 sit with the Lamoille North Modified Unified Union School District, a separate district.
Cambridge Elementary School (official district site, under the Lamoille North SU).

sources.note: Cambridge School District board minutes, October 7, 2026 (district document): 'School Board Members: Rachael Mascolino, Brendan McCarthy, Jan Sander, Mark Stebbins, Denise Webster' -- the full five-member board, none absent; the board is five directors elected at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b)).

Cambridge School District official results notice, March 3, 2026 annual meeting: Jan Sander elected to the 3-year seat and Rachael Mascolino to the 2-year seat. The March 4, 2025 annual meeting minutes elect Mark Stebbins (3-year seat) and Denise Webster (warned 2-year seat -- the minutes' motion text saying '3 years' is a boilerplate slip the district repeats for 2-year seats; the warned article controls).

Cambridge board minutes, June 3, 2026: Lori Hebert [sic] 'submitted a letter of resignation effective June 30' on taking a teaching job at the school. She had been elected March 5, 2024 to a 3-year term and served on the board through the March 4, 2026 reorganization; her membership is ended in 2026. The district's canonical spelling is Hebert with an accented e (Hébert).

Cambridge board minutes, July 8, 2026: 'J. Sander moved to appoint Brendan McCarthy to the vacancy on the school board... the motion was passed.' The vacancy was Lori Hebert's (resigned effective June 30, 2026), whose elected term runs to 2027; the appointment minute states no end date.
